# JPM — Technicals

## TL;DR

As of run 20260504_182958, JPM has pulled back to $307.81 on the hourly chart — sitting directly on the 20-times-tested $307.29 volume-confirmed hourly support. The daily trend remains structurally intact (EMA stack, ADX 41.45, Apr 30 engulfing candle off $306.57 swing low), but intraday momentum is negative: price is below all hourly EMAs and MACD histogram is −0.52. Entry is hard-blocked by cluster cap, not correlation advisory alone — BAC+JPM combined exposure would be $1,322 vs the 30% ($538) cap on a $1,794 portfolio.
